model.summary: Model favors NE by 6.8 points (72% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (NE +3.7), Quarterback rating (NE +2.8), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (NE +2.2). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 42.4 total points (MIA 18, NE 25). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.9), Wind x pass rate (lowers total 0.8), Divisional game (lowers total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
